description:
First city-scale currency hulls pilots launch: reputation ledgers issuance and currency logistics exchange running live.

definition: Simulates Reputation Currency Systems operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where reputation ledgers monitoring, currency logistics redundancy, or sybil resistance maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Reputation Currency Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Reputation Currency Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Reputation Currency Systems — money based on earned reputation.

Phase 1 — Prove (reputation ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (currency logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sybil resistance): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (score algorithms): currency hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and communities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
